_nota: Mantra delle card LinkedIn disegnate su Canva (venerdì: Notizie AI, lunedì: Lavoro AI). Lista unica: ogni card prende il primo numero libero, mai due volte lo stesso. 'prossimi' sono già assegnati da Paolo e vanno usati per primi dalla card indicata. La routine aggiorna questo file a ogni uscita. Dal 20 ottobre 2026 il testo è in INGLESE (richiesta di Paolo): stessa numerazione, quelli già usciti sono usciti in italiano.
mantra: Your next colleague might be an AI.
Your next job interview might start without a human.
You hired an AI. Who explains to it how things work here?
The new colleague knows everything. Even what it makes up.
Your boss wants to use AI. The AI would like better instructions.
The meeting could have been an email. Now an AI writes the email.
Your job requires experience. Your replacement requires a password.
An AI has joined the team. The responsibilities are still all yours.
The perfect résumé may not have been written by the candidate.
AI saves you time. Your boss has already found a way to fill it.
The tireless colleague doesn't drink coffee. It consumes electricity.
The chatbot agrees with you. Even when it would be better not to.
AI has an answer for everything. The problem is that “everything”.
The answer was flawless. Too bad it was made up.
You asked for a source. It wrote that too.
It never raises its voice. It can be wrong with great confidence.
Doubt is human. With a chatbot, you have to ask for it.
It answered in one second. Now take a minute to check.
The AI understood the question. Did you understand the answer?
The chatbot sounds like an expert. That is exactly the delicate part.
You corrected the AI. It thanked you and made the same mistake again.
The photo is perfect. The photographer never existed.
You recognised the voice. That doesn't mean you know who is speaking.
That video has a witness. The problem is that it's generated.
The singer doesn't breathe. The song does.
The model doesn't exist. The advertising contract might.
A story moves you. It was written by something that feels nothing.
The sunset is spectacular. The sun wasn't there.
Your face can appear in a video. Without you filming anything.
The next scam might call you with the voice of a family member.
Seeing used to be believing. Now it takes something more.
AI is free. Until you find out what you want to do with it.
You bought a subscription. Talent is sold separately.
Everyone wants to make money with AI. Some sell courses on exactly that.
AI can open a business for you. You still have to find the customers.
You automated everything. Including the mistakes.
Your digital assistant needs a human assistant.
AI works while you sleep. Check what it did when you wake up.
You delegated a decision. The responsibility didn't follow the click.
The product is born in an afternoon. A reason to buy it may take longer.
The chatbot sells the idea beautifully. Now try selling it to a customer.
The machine learns fast. Are we learning to trust it?
AI can write the rules. That doesn't mean it follows them.
The future has arrived. The instructions are still updating.
Your phone got smart. The notifications are still questionable.
You told it everything. Do you know where that “everything” ends up?
AI knows you better. Every time you press “Send”.
The robot smiles. It's not a guarantee.
AI can do the homework. Learning is still up to you.
You found the answer. Maybe you were asking the wrong question.
The next big change might arrive with a small update.
